model.pooling: SBERT modules; mean of overflow windows then L2

selection_policy.tie_break: prefer larger cosine silhouette in original embedding space, then stability and coverage
selection_policy.interpretation: heuristic operational tolerance, not statistical significance or labeled accuracy
selection_policy.candidate_family: SBERT + UMAP + DBSCAN + optional centroid topic merging
selection_policy.stability_test: final topic partitions on two seeded UMAP projections, after merging when configured
selection_policy.coherence_search: descending composite score; all candidates in the best passing score tolerance band are evaluated; lower scores are explicitly marked unevaluated

coherence.tokenization: c-TF-IDF CountVectorizer analyzer: stopword-filtered unigrams followed by bigrams; phrases remain single tokens
coherence.reference_scope: all unique embedding_text sentences, including DBSCAN noise; no cluster concatenation
coherence.aggregation: unweighted mean of all non-noise topics; any unscorable topic invalidates the mean
coherence.interpretation: in-sample lexical coherence of topic terms, not accuracy or held-out generalization

evaluation_scope: Internal comparison on this corpus; no labeled semantic ground truth or universal-best claim
stability_scope: Final topic partitions on two seeded UMAP projections, including configured centroid merging; ARI uses union of assigned points, noise singletons and excludes shared noise. This is not labeled accuracy.
pipeline: SBERT multilingual -> UMAP -> Euclidean DBSCAN -> optional SBERT centroid topic merging -> c-TF-IDF topic descriptions
dates: Original WIB values/accuracy preserved as source metadata, not clustering features

model.score: maximum cosine to reference examples; NOT probability
model.pooling: SBERT overflow windows mean followed by L2 normalization

parent_context.rule: Native root from source URL; parent only from checksum-verified matching source audit. Missing/conflicting parents are not inferred.

context_relevance.validation: Automatic semantic prototype labels; cosine thresholds are provisional, not human-calibrated; no measured precision/recall.

topic_narratives.input_scope: Top 10 positive c-TF-IDF keyword weights and up to 10 fitted sentences ranked by centroid cosine similarity per topic
topic_narratives.interpretation: AI-generated synthesis of keywords and representative sentences; not a quotation, population estimate or an additional coherence measurement
